title: Aqua Guard Water Filter Installation
summary: Rotary Club of Mumbai Sher-E-Punjab installed an Aqua Guard water filter at Zilla Parishad School, Hatne, Deherje Village, Vikramgad, on 1st November 2026, fulfilling a requirement brought forward by Radha Nair.
description:
Rotary Club of Mumbai Sher-E-Punjab installed an Aqua Guard water filter at Zilla Parishad School, Hatne, Deherje Village, Vikramgad, on 1st November 2026, fulfilling a requirement brought forward by Radha Nair.

The project, led and sponsored by President Rtn. Sunita Bedi, involved an expenditure of ₹20000.

The installation will benefit over 120 students by providing access to clean and safe drinking water on a daily basis. This initiative aims to promote better health, hygiene and well-being among the children.
location: Zilla Parishad School, Hatne, Deherje Village, Vikramgad, Mumbai, Maharashtra
